completeness.why: Four sites pass their raw value to getExpectedScheduleAmount (which the existing getScheduledAmount now also delegates to). The template site calls it with an explicit rounding mode, but still computes that mode with its own op === 'isbetween' conditional, a dispatch the shared definition settles by value type, so it is scored partial.

interface.why: One function taking the raw amount (missing, number or range) with a single explicit rounding-mode parameter for the preserved template inconsistency and a default for the rest; the mode name 'template' names a caller rather than the rounding behaviour, and the template caller re-derives the mode from op.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline ternaries are removed and getScheduledAmount delegates to the new function; no reshaped copy remains.
